secrets.name: SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: Incoming Webhook URL do canal do Slack (api.slack.com/apps → Incoming Webhooks).

secrets.name: SLACK_WORKFLOW_WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: URL de gatilho de um Workflow do Slack (Workflow Builder → Webhook trigger).

secrets.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Bot token (xoxb-...) com o escopo chat:write, para publicar via chat.postMessage.

secrets.name: SLACK_CHANNEL
secrets.description: Canal usado com SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, por exemplo #geral ou C0123456789.
